notes_for_editor: Only one source names this lookout, and it gives location, agency and status only: no build date, builder, design, height, staffing or fire history. The Oklahoma news and forestry searches turned up nothing about a Blue Mountain tower in Le Flore County. Several unrelated Blue Mountain lookouts appeared (New York, Montana, Washington, and a Blue Mountain in Arkansas), so do not merge them. Search snippets (not read) show a Forest Service Blue Mountain turkey hunting area and prescribed-burn units in Le Flore County, but nothing ties them to a tower. The record coordinates (34.8215, -94.7727) were not checked against the site. Next step: Ouachita National Forest Kiamichi Ranger District records.
